name: Rennet Whey
description: Historical recipe from Miss Leslie's Complete Cookery (1851). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: small bit of rennet about two inches square
ingredients.originalText: a small bit of rennet about two inches square

ingredients.name: pitcher of warm milk
ingredients.originalText: a quart pitcher of warm milk

instructions.text: Wash a small bit of rennet about two inches square, in cold water, to get off the salt.
Put it into a tea-cup and pour on it sufficient lukewarm water to cover it.
Let it stand all night, and in the morning stir the rennet water into a quart pitcher of warm milk.
Cover it, and set it near the fire till a firm curd is formed.
Pour off the whey from it, and it will be found an excellent and cooling drink.

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Wash a small bit of rennet about two inches square, in cold water, to get off the salt.
2. Put it into a tea-cup and pour on it sufficient lukewarm water to cover it.
3. Let it stand all night, and in the morning stir the rennet water into a quart pitcher of warm milk.
4. Cover it, and set it near the fire till a firm curd is formed.
5. Pour off the whey from it, and it will be found an excellent and cooling drink.
